description:
The easiest way to generate incredible videos with the leading state of the art model, Seedance 2 and 2.5. 

Turn a prompt into polished short form video. Use it for social posts, product stories, cinematic concepts, and AI-assisted creative production.

- No subscription required
- Create videos from natural-language creative direction
- Use images, video, and audio as generation references
- Edit videos
- Extend videos
- Easily download or share completed videos
- Low cost usage based pricing depends on video resolution and duration.
- Use your Infoseek account for easy access to our library of GPT apps
